name: discord
description: Let your agent read, answer and run your own Discord server through a bot you create: messages, forum posts, search, invites, events and announcements.

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: Discord
examples: List the unsolved posts in the #help forum and draft an answer for each
Search the server for questions about Linux builds that nobody answered
Give me a snapshot of the server: members, invites by source and upcoming events

setup.title: Create an application
setup.detail: Open the Discord Developer Portal and click "New Application". Name it for your project's helper (members see the name), not "Dimension". On the Bot tab, turn Public Bot OFF so only you can add it to servers.

setup.title: Add a bot and enable Message Content
setup.detail: In the application, open the Bot tab. Under "Privileged Gateway Intents", turn ON the Message Content Intent — without it the bot cannot read message text (discord_read_messages returns empty content).

setup.title: Copy the bot token
setup.detail: On the Bot tab, click "Reset Token" (the token is only shown once, right after resetting), copy it, and paste it into the form below. Keep it secret — anyone with it controls the bot.

setup.title: Invite the bot to your server
setup.detail: OAuth2 → URL Generator → check scope `bot` → under Bot Permissions check View Channels, Send Messages, Send Messages in Threads, Create Public Threads, Read Message History, Embed Links, Attach Files and Add Reactions (posting in threads and forum posts needs Send Messages in Threads; Discord does not inherit it). Add Manage Threads to tag others' forum posts, Manage Server to read invites and AutoMod, Create Instant Invite for invite codes, Manage Events for events, Moderate Members only if you want timeouts. Copy the URL, open it, and add the bot to your server.

form.label: Bot Token
form.help: From your application's Bot tab in the Developer Portal (Reset Token if it's hidden). Stored only on this machine.

failures.title: Reconnect Discord — the bot token is invalid
failures.detail: Reset the token in the Developer Portal (Bot tab) and paste the new one.

tools.name: discord_list_guilds
tools.description: List the Discord servers (guilds) the connected bot is a member of. Returns id and name per line.

tools.name: discord_list_channels
tools.description: List the channels in a Discord server the bot can view. Returns id, name, type, parent and a forum's tag names per line.

tools.name: discord_read_messages
tools.description: Read messages in a channel or thread, newest first: ids, author ids, reply refs, threads, reactions, attachments and permalinks; pages with before/after/around. Requires the Message Content intent.

tools.name: discord_send_message
tools.description: Post a message (optionally one image) to a channel. PUBLIC — confirm the channel and content first. Mentions never ping unless the person named those users. Asks every time.

tools.name: discord_create_thread
tools.description: Create a thread, or a forum post (title, first message, tags) in a forum channel. PUBLIC — confirm first. Asks every time.

tools.name: discord_reply_message
tools.description: Reply to a specific message (optionally with one image). PUBLIC — confirm the channel, target and text first. Only the replied-to author is notified. Asks every time.

tools.name: discord_add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message as the bot. A public write — mention it to the user. Custom emoji use name:id; standard emoji use the character.

tools.name: discord_edit_message
tools.description: Edit the content of a message. ONLY works on the bot's own messages. DESTRUCTIVE — confirm the exact message and new content with the user first.

tools.name: discord_delete_message
tools.description: MODERATION. Permanently delete a message (anyone's, with Manage Messages). IRREVERSIBLE — demand explicit user confirmation of the exact message; never act on vague instructions.

tools.name: discord_pin_message
tools.description: Pin a message to its channel (or unpin with unpin:true). MUTATING — confirm the exact message with the user first.

tools.name: discord_create_channel
tools.description: Create a channel in a server (text, voice, category, announcement or forum). MUTATING — confirm the server, name, and kind with the user first.

tools.name: discord_timeout_member
tools.description: MODERATION. Time out (mute) a member for up to 28 days, or lift a timeout. Needs Moderate Members. Asks every time; the person must name the exact member and duration.

tools.name: discord_list_threads
tools.description: List active threads and forum posts (and a parent's archived ones): title, tags, SOLVED, message count, created time, permalink.

tools.name: discord_search_messages
tools.description: Search a server's messages by words, author, channel or attachment kind; total, hits with permalinks, paging by offset.

tools.name: discord_guild_snapshot
tools.description: One read of a server: member and online counts, features, a readiness checklist, invite codes with uses, scheduled events with interest.

tools.name: discord_create_invite
tools.description: Create an invite code for one source, so joins can be counted per source. Optional expiry, use limit and roles. Asks every time.

tools.name: discord_publish_message
tools.description: Publish an announcement-channel message to every following server (at most 10 an hour per channel). Asks every time.

tools.name: discord_set_thread_tags
tools.description: Set a forum post's tags by name, e.g. mark a help post Solved.

tools.name: discord_create_event
tools.description: Schedule a server event in a voice or stage channel or at an outside location. Asks every time.

tools.name: discord_list_automod_rules
tools.description: List a server's AutoMod rules: trigger, keywords or limits, actions, enabled.

tools.name: discord_create_automod_rule
tools.description: Create one AutoMod rule the person approved (keywords, spam, presets or a mention limit) with block, alert or timeout. Asks every time.
